summary: pytest collection could not import backend because project root was not on Python path
root_cause: CI working directory was set but import path was not explicitly exported
fix: set PYTHONPATH=. and invoke python -m pytest; compile scripts as well as backend
regression: GitHub Actions run on every relevant push/PR

summary: mounted-volume/injected-port smoke test reported a UID assertion failure after the application was already healthy
root_cause: docker exec starts the diagnostic process using the image default user, so os.geteuid() measured the diagnostic process instead of the running Uvicorn PID 1
fix: inspect /proc/1/status for uid 10001 and separately assert /data is owned by uid 10001
regression: CI smoke test now verifies injected PORT, mounted-volume ownership, PID 1 non-root identity and /api/health
